import struct

with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-lz4.b2frame', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f'Total frame size: {len(data)}')
print(f'First 100 bytes hex: {data[:100].hex()}')

# Frame header layout (from frame.h):
# FRAME_HEADER_MAGIC = 2
# FRAME_HEADER_LEN = 11
# FRAME_LEN = 16
# FRAME_FLAGS = 25
# FRAME_TYPE = 26
# FRAME_CODECS = 27
# FRAME_NBYTES = 30
# FRAME_CBYTES = 39
# FRAME_TYPESIZE = 48
# FRAME_BLOCKSIZE = 53
# FRAME_CHUNKSIZE = 58
# FRAME_NTHREADS_C = 63
# FRAME_NTHREADS_D = 66
# FRAME_HAS_VLMETALAYERS = 68
# FRAME_FILTER_PIPELINE = 70
# FRAME_HEADER_MINLEN = 87

# Check magic
print(f'Magic bytes: {data[0:2].hex()}')

# header_len at offset 2 (8 bytes big-endian)
header_len = struct.unpack('>q', data[2:10])[0]
print(f'header_len: {header_len}')

# frame_len at offset 11 (8 bytes big-endian)
frame_len = struct.unpack('>q', data[11:19])[0]
print(f'frame_len: {frame_len}')

# flags at offset 19 (1 byte)
flags = data[19]
print(f'flags: {flags:#x}')

# frame_type at offset 20
frame_type = data[20]
print(f'frame_type: {frame_type}')

# codecs at offset 21
codecs = data[21]
print(f'codecs: {codecs:#x}')

# nbytes at offset 22 (8 bytes)
nbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[22:30])[0]
print(f'nbytes: {nbytes}')

# cbytes at offset 30 (8 bytes)
cbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[30:38])[0]
print(f'cbytes: {cbytes}')

# typesize at offset 38 (4 bytes)
typesize = struct.unpack('>i', data[38:42])[0]
print(f'typesize: {typesize}')

# blocksize at offset 42 (4 bytes)
blocksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[42:46])[0]
print(f'blocksize: {blocksize}')

# chunksize at offset 46 (4 bytes)
chunksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[46:50])[0]
print(f'chunksize: {chunksize}')

# nthreads_c at offset 50 (2 bytes)
nthreads_c = struct.unpack('>h', data[50:52])[0]
print(f'nthreads_c: {nthreads_c}')

# nthreads_d at offset 52 (2 bytes)
nthreads_d = struct.unpack('>h', data[52:54])[0]
print(f'nthreads_d: {nthreads_d}')

# has_vlmetalayers at offset 54 (1 byte)
has_vlmetalayers = data[54]
print(f'has_vlmetalayers: {has_vlmetalayers}')

# filter_pipeline at offset 55 (1 byte)
filter_pipeline = data[55]
print(f'filter_pipeline: {filter_pipeline}')

# nchunks = nbytes / chunksize
nchunks = nbytes // chunksize if chunksize > 0 else 0
print(f'nchunks (computed): {nchunks}')
"
